scope: Metadata-only four-way legacy/local-window-v2 by complete exact normalized-role index; no generator, fingerprint, forward chemistry or model
role_index_policy: For a query with one of two selected exact map-stripped roles: order the complete role-matching catalog subset by existing bucket-distance, bucket-key and SHA hash first, then fill from the ordinary catalog subset without duplicates up to total 8192. Other roles and incomplete index use legacy pool. This is a metadata calculation only; no generator query is altered.

analysis.interpretation: Only the shared aryl-bromide leaf reaches the hypothetical capped pool, under local-window-v2 with or without role index. Neither saved heteroaryl leaf nor the aniline reaches the pool for its needed rule/slot. The two exact selected normalized-role indexes do not apply to any inner rule-036 query, even where a leaf itself matches a selected aryl-halide pattern. This metadata reachability is not generation or route recovery evidence.

decision.reason: Exact role indexing plus local retrieval features did not recover either complete known three-leaf set. Catalog role matches are still broad, and the fixed top-two outer role indexes do not apply to inner-036 caller roles.
decision.role_description_correction: The selected N SMARTS includes aliphatic amines as well as aromatic NH2 alternatives. It is not an aniline-only index.
decision.next_scope: Redesign within-role capped pool composition and query scale using saved bucket metadata first. Require a fixed generic policy, existing retrieval controls, actual candidate selection and full-route tests before production adoption.

same_site_only_followup.premise: The missing aniline leaf uses the exact selected N role already and remains outside every relevant tested pool. Exact-first related-role reuse cannot change those queries.
same_site_only_followup.conclusion: Related-role reuse alone cannot recover a complete known leaf set; it does not justify another catalog scan or production change.
same_site_only_followup.limitation: This conclusion concerns the two saved known witness sets and the specified exact-first reuse policy, not all possible routes.
